title.zh: 废止第920号共和国法第一节标题C子节(a)项第三十四款(e)项，并将其中为山地省 Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk 公路建设所拨付的四万五千比索款项予以撤销的法案
title.en: An Act Repealing Item Thirty-Four (e), Subsection (a), Title C of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, and Appropriating the Amount of Forty-Five Thousand Pesos Therein Provided for the Construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province
title.orig: An Act Repealing Item Thirty-Four (e), Subsection (a), Title C of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, and Appropriating the Amount of Forty-Five Thousand Pesos Therein Provided for the Construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province
title.vi: Đạo luật hủy bỏ Mục Ba Mươi Bốn (e), Tiểu mục (a), Tiêu đề C của Phần Một của Đạo luật Cộng hòa Số Chín Trăm Hai Mươi và hủy khoản kinh phí Bốn Mươi Lăm Nghìn Peso được quy định trong đó để xây dựng tuyến đường Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk tại Tỉnh Mountain
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิกถอนข้อสามสิบสี่(ง)ย่อย(ก)หัวข้อคของส่วนหนึ่งแห่งพระราชบัญญัติสาธารณรัฐฉบับที่เก้าร้อยยี่สิบและเพิกถอนจำนวนเงินสี่หมื่นห้าพันเปโซที่จัดสรรไว้สำหรับการก่อสร้างถนนคาลานัน–ตูกา–ปิณุกปุกในจังหวัดเมาเทน
title.id: Undang-Undang Mencabut Butir Tiga Puluh Empat (e), Subbagian (a), Judul C Bagian Satu dari Undang-Undang Republik Nomor Sembilan Ratus Dua Puluh serta Membatalkan Jumlah Empat Puluh Lima Ribu Peso yang Disediakan di dalamnya untuk Pembangunan Jalan Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk di Provinsi Mountain
title.ms: Akta Membatalkan Perkara Tiga Puluh Empat (e), Bahagian Kecil (a), Tajuk C Bahagian Satu Akta Republik Nombor Sembilan Ratus Dua Puluh dan Membatalkan Jumlah Empat Puluh Lima Ribu Peso yang Diperuntukkan di dalamnya bagi Pembinaan Jalan Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk di Wilayah Mountain

text.en: Item thirty-four (e), subsection (a), Title C of section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty, on page one hundred and fourteen thereof, is hereby repealed, and the sum of forty-five thousand pesos therein provided is hereby appropriated for the construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 10, 1955.
